name: InferEdge
long_description:
InferEdge provides agentic AI solutions to buy-side firms under an outcome-based, forward-deployed model. We build systems that fit customer workflows for research, portfolio analysis, risk and client servicing. Everything can be hosted inside a private cloud, and the system comes with citations, traceability and guardrails.

Our team has deep quantitative finance and technology experience, enabling us to deliver outcomes effectively.
one_liner: AI solutions for investment firms under a forward deployed model
